categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Shudao Equipment & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: cryogenic technology equipment manufacturing, transportation service equipment manufacturing, gas investment and operation, and clean energy investment and operation. The company focuses on natural gas liquefaction, air separation, electronic special gases, and rare gases, while also expanding into hydrogen energy and integrated transportation energy services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cryogenic liquefaction and separation technologies, including natural gas liquefaction, air separation, helium extraction, hydrogen liquefaction, and electronic special gas production. It employs advanced manufacturing capabilities for LNG units, liquid air separation units, and integrated energy stations, with strong R&D in hydrogen fuel cell systems, large-scale LNG storage tanks, and modular skid-mounted equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial gas producers, chemical and petrochemical companies, transportation sectors requiring LNG and hydrogen fueling stations, and infrastructure projects in steel, machinery, semiconductor, medical, and food industries. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets along the Belt and Road Initiative, including countries like Indonesia and Nigeria.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Sichuan Province. It also has expanding overseas markets, notably in Southeast Asia and Africa, including Indonesia and Nigeria. Domestic operations cover key regions such as Sichuan, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, and other provinces with strategic energy and industrial clusters.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Shudao Equipment & Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on manufacturing cryogenic and air separation equipment, as well as operating gas and clean energy projects. It also extends into upstream investment through industrial gas production and hydrogen energy infrastructure development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in cryogenic liquefaction, hydrogen energy, and integrated energy solutions. Strategic R&D priorities include large-scale hydrogen liquefaction, fuel cell stack production, advanced air separation technologies, and digital transformation of manufacturing processes. It actively pursues collaborations, including a joint venture with Toyota for hydrogen fuel cell system production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the design, manufacture, and sale of cryogenic and air separation equipment, as well as transportation energy equipment like LNG and hydrogen fueling stations. Additional income streams include gas sales from industrial and special gases, clean energy project operations, and related engineering and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's cryogenic technology and industrial gas equipment manufacturing sector, with competitive advantages in technology and project execution. It competes with domestic and international manufacturers of LNG and air separation equipment, as well as emerging hydrogen energy technology providers. Its strategic partnerships and comprehensive product portfolio strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 861.5 million, a 28.9% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.37 million, up 121.67%. The company has shown strong growth in contract signings and cash flow from operations, reflecting expanding business scale and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Shudao Equipment & Technology differentiates itself through advanced cryogenic technology expertise, comprehensive product lines covering LNG, air separation, and hydrogen energy equipment, and integrated energy solutions. Its strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, and strategic alliances enable it to offer high-efficiency, reliable, and customized solutions that support clean energy transition and industrial upgrading.
